checks.reason: Warm, short sentences, uses greeting 'Hey' and first name, says thank you, not pushy.
Mentions the charcoal grill and Ember & Spice and the Mango Lassi welcome offer, specific to this restaurant.
Plain English, clear.
No previous outputs to repeat.
No em-dashes, emojis or banned phrases (words_to_avoid is empty). The en dash in the template's date range is added by the template, not the draft.
Mango Lassi is a menu item and the signup offer. Charcoal grill matches the cuisine and menu. Dine-in condition is stated in the draft's offer conditions as the maker's own terms.
discount_value_gbp 3.95 matches the Mango Lassi menu price. Segment size of 5 matches can_be_emailed 5.
Valid 12 Oct to 11 Nov 2026 is in the future or today. Send at 5pm Monday 12 October is within opening hours (12:00 to 23:00) and the rendered dates match.
'Mango Lassi' and 'Ember & Spice' match the sources.
No causal claims.
No halal, allergen or dietary claims made.
Terms are clear: free item, dine-in only, with any order, one per person, with dates shown. No fake urgency. free_item is an approved offer type and within the cap.
Audience is unredeemed sign-ups, with no targeting by personal traits.
No review incentive.
Only a first-name placeholder is used. No other personal data.
No financial, legal or staffing advice.
Email includes an unsubscribe link and a delete data link in the footer. No platform rule issues.

Subject is 34 characters (under 50). Headline is 4 words (under 8). Body is about 36 words (under 60). Offer is on the current menu. Dates and conditions are clear. No em-dashes. Emojis not used. Email channel only.
Preview shows the restaurant name header and consistent template styling. The brand kit was not supplied, so nothing contradicts it.
The template's no-photo version is used, as the photo library is empty.
Copy fits on mobile with no overflow or cut-off text.
'[First name]' appears in the preview, but the template states it is filled in per customer, so it is not placeholder text left in the final send. No empty slots or broken elements.
